title: Almost all graphs are determined by their generalized spectrum
summary: Haemers' conjecture for the generalized spectrum asserts that almost all graphs are determined by their generalized spectrum, that is, for almost all graphs $G$, every graph with the same spectrum as $G$ whose complement has the same spectrum as the complement of $G$ is isomorphic to $G$. We prove this conjecture by showing that the random graph $G(n,1/2)$ is determined by its generalized spectrum with probability tending to one.
